---
title: "Install"
---

## Requirements

CompStats is a pure-Python package. Its runtime dependencies are numpy, scikit-learn (version 1.3.0
or later), pandas, seaborn (version 0.13.0 or later) and statsmodels. The package tqdm is optional.
When it is installed, progress bars are shown while the bootstrap samples are computed.

## From PyPI

```bash
pip install CompStats
```

## From conda-forge

```bash
conda install --channel conda-forge CompStats
```

## From source

The following commands install the package in editable mode, together with the dependencies
required to run the test suite.

```bash
git clone https://github.com/INGEOTEC/CompStats.git
cd CompStats
pip install -e ".[test]"
```

## Checking the installation

The installed version is printed with the following command.

```bash
python -c "import CompStats; print(CompStats.__version__)"
```
